notes: Big one: Add a village straight from AnyRoR — pick district, taluka, village and survey live on the site, no setup or waiting for us. iRCMS now works for Nadiad-area villages, and old VF-7/12 lets you choose the matching old survey number. Re-adding a village no longer makes a duplicate (existing duplicates merge automatically); long-press a village to remove it. Report-a-problem now carries saved logs. Your records are kept.
